sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.used_for: Section 5 disclosure sentence (verbatim): "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." Section 5 requires it be stated clearly and prominently on the Site. Section 6 makes a Section 5 violation a material breach. Page shows 'Updated: October 15, 2025'.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Amazon Associates Central)
sources.used_for: Participation Requirements s.2(a)-(b): Special Links must use the Associates ID; tag format 'XXXXX-##' or 'such other format as we may designate'; prices may be shown only if served by Amazon or via PA API/Creators API. s.3(e): site must disclose cookies/pixels and visitor choices. s.4: no offline promotion; solicited email/SMS only. s.6(a): Program Content may not be altered. Commission Income Statement s.2(e) (Redirecting Link disqualification) and s.2(g) (improperly formatted links). Page shows 'Updated: April 14, 2026'.

sources.title: Associates Program Commission schedule (Appendix)
sources.used_for: Commission rates are NOT recorded. The page returned a sign-in screen to this session.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.used_for: Disclose any financial relationship; place disclosure where it is 'hard to miss' with the endorsement; avoid vague terms ('sp', 'spon', 'collab'); do not mix into hashtags or links; do not assume a platform tool is enough. Brochure dated November 2019.

sources.title: 16 CFR 255.0 - Purpose and definitions (Endorsement Guides)
sources.publisher: U.S. Federal Trade Commission / eCFR (authoritative but unofficial)
sources.used_for: s.255.0(f) defines 'clear and conspicuous': difficult to miss, easily understandable, and 'unavoidable' in interactive electronic media. Published version 88 FR 48102 (July 26, 2023).

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (Search Central)
sources.used_for: rel="sponsored" for advertisements or paid placements; multiple rel values allowed; page last updated 2025-12-10.

sources.title: Configuring a publishing source for your GitHub Pages site (GitHub Docs)
sources.used_for: Publishing from a branch supports the root or /docs folder; GitHub Pages sites are public. Static hosting only: this document describes no server-side processing.
